animations.name: Strong Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE stylish Dee-Jay-style sweeping diagonal crouching uppercut across the clip (strictly one uppercut only, never twice), pure body motion only in empty air: staying low on the baseline without standing tall, he dips his lead shoulder low with a smooth rhythmic torso twist, then whips ONE wide sweeping diagonal rising hook-uppercut across his body toward the upper-right (~55 degrees) while his rear arm pulls back for momentum; brief apex, then smooth return to the starting crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, cap, navy sweater, jeans, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Keep the entire body and raised fist cleanly inside the 512x512 frame with margin on all edges. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
